ideas.title: A top that floats over a stone ring
ideas.critique: This builds on the existing top with a real new step: a rigid body held up only by em.jl's force and torque, inside a narrow stability window that nobody can script. Adding and filing washers gives the player a real tuning game. It fails completely if the window gets widened by hand or the weight gets nudged until it floats, and then it is just one more top film on a board.

ideas.title: Three stones, one pendulum, the friends bet
ideas.critique: The chaotic magnetic pendulum is a well-known desk toy, so the swing on its own is predictable. The pebble map that slowly draws the basin fractal from real games is the strong part. The bets and cheers are puppet reactions to an outcome, and a single spike on a thread adds little to the road that the chain or the coil don't add.

ideas.title: Shake a stone through a coil, the needle kicks
ideas.nearest: A wire that spins by itself
ideas.critique: Induction made from the stone's own field, with a current from the wire's real resistance, is the far end of the road reached early, and it is honest Faraday. To a viewer it is a needle twitching beside a hoop, which reads as subtle and expected. The rhythm game is thin, and a hand-placed coil whose length is typed in instead of wound keeps the setup a rig.

ideas.title: A magnet that falls slowly through copper
same_form: A wire that spins by itself
ideas.critique: A thin-sheet eddy solve driven by each material's conductivity is new physics the island has never had, and the honey-slow drop really surprises people. The film as pitched is the island's tired recipe again: three variants side by side, a fixed camera, different outcomes. Guessing what the friends' things will do is a light game you play once.

ideas.title: The friends try to steal Lumi's iron tail
ideas.critique: This is round 1's spike chain with a chase added. Creature grips as forces on a solved chain are a real way for the friends to touch the physics, and breaking where the field says is honest. From outside it is still the stone with spikes and friends running after it, and the chase AI will most likely be a scripted pursuit.

ideas.title: Iron sand that shows every field
ideas.critique: This is round 1's black sand made a bit more exact. Thousands of GPU grains that chain into tufts are still the one thing here a viewer has never seen on the island, and the field becomes visible without labels. Raking pictures is a soft goal, and the pitch only holds up if the neighbour relaxation really produces the tufts instead of grains being steered along drawn field lines.
